I assumed the chain had to be contiguous, but it only requires relative ordering. Next time, I will first place the fixed-position items (Red at 6, Black at 4) and then identify the specific slots available for the relative chains. I will realize that since positions 4 and 6 are taken, the chain $Blue < Gray < Orange$ must occupy positions 1, 2, and 3, and the chain $Orange < White < Red$ implies Orange is at 3, White at 5, and Red at 6. This leaves position 2 for Gray and position 1 for Blue, with Purple filling the remaining spot at 7. I will then verify the final order against all clues before selecting the option that matches the position of the target book.
